data.objective: Users can access project management and system menus as global pages without a project selector while project business authorization remains scoped to the selected project.

requirements.statement: Project management and system routes must not initialize or display the project context selector.
acceptance: At /projects and /system/**, no desktop, standard-header, or mobile-drawer selector is rendered
A previously stored project selection remains available when returning to a project business route
counterexample: A system page invokes project initialization or renders a project selector

requirements.statement: The project management route must be visible without a current project only when the user has project:project:list in at least one accessible project.
acceptance: The no-project authorization route tree includes /projects for a user with project:project:list in one accessible project
The route tree excludes /projects for users with only other project permissions or no project-management permission
counterexample: A project:plan:list-only user receives /projects, or an authorized user loses it without a selected project

requirements.statement: Project business routes and APIs must retain project-context initialization and server-side X-Project-Id authorization.
acceptance: A project business route still initializes context and displays the selector
Project APIs still reject missing or forged project context
counterexample: A project API succeeds without valid X-Project-Id after the change

invariants: No JWT, public API, database, project data, or V202 migration changes
Existing stored project selection is not cleared
Project data scope and entity authorization remain server-enforced
constraints: No production access or sensitive configuration
Use existing Vue Router, Pinia, Element Plus, Spring and JdbcTemplate patterns
non_goals: Changing project membership or role data
Changing project APIs or HTTP header contract
Refactoring the route tree or shared UI components
Changing the V202 menu text migration
